lines.text: God made man in His own likeness, male and female, and He blessed them.
Enoch walked with God, and then he was no more, because God had taken him away.
After Noah was 500 years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham, and Abraham.
The sons of God took as wives whomever they chose, so the LORD said man's days would be 70 years.
The LORD said He would blot out man from the earth, but Noah found favor in His eyes.
